groups.evidence_kind: diagnostic isoform states; not individually proven epistatic sites

groups.note: AGSA follows the per-site polarity relative to P. leucopus; it is not a reconstructed full ancestral sequence or evidence for one path from betaII to betaI.

order_status.reason: Storz 2009 assays naturally occurring hemolysates with known isoform composition; no single-mutant trajectory, temporal order or obligate precedence was measured. Beta outgroup polarization gives direction per site, not order.

structure_scope.purpose: homologous geometric scaffold, not the experimental deer-mouse structure
structure_scope.mapping_note: Paper mature residue n maps to PDB author n, then to human UniProt n+1 via the authoritative offsets JSON. Human residue identities differ from deer allele identities. Alignment columns must be mapped separately for each run.

missing_for_validation: A source that actually measures order is required for an order score; no amount of sequence completion supplies missing temporal information in Storz 2009.

Exact experimental full sequences and phased HBA-T1/T2 and HBB-T1/T2 genotypes/expression for the Fig.3 hemolysates; diagnostic strings alone do not specify the whole protein or the mixed alpha isoform composition.
Storz 2009 supplement, especially numeric P50/effector data Table S2 and genotype metadata, is not present locally.
A run-specific mapping from each model alignment column to mature deer-mouse position and the scaffold; consistent paralog assignment and a declared alpha-beta interface convention.

The alignments currently add one high-type deer-mouse representative, not the segregating allele panel. Alternative haplotypes remain in local FASTAs; identical alpha representatives in HBA1/HBA2 are not independent evidence.

If validating intersubunit alpha-beta epistasis, a declared way to combine the separate HBA/HBB model runs and explicit study-supported scoring targets; diagnostic association alone does not prove every listed site epistatic.

corrections_to_existing.correction: These are five and four diagnostic polymorphism sites; Storz 2009 did not assay an exhaustive 32- or16-genotype single-substitution design.

corrections_to_existing.claim: no Peromyscus maniculatus sequence exists in HBA1/HBA2/HBB alignments
corrections_to_existing.correction: Stale: HLperManSon3 occurs in all three files and data/sequences/deer_mouse/README.md documents merged high-type representatives and provenance caveats.

corrections_to_existing.claim: HB2 does epistaeon assign beta sites to a coupled group distinct from alpha sites
corrections_to_existing.correction: Beta haplotype DPG sensitivity is measured, but this does not establish a complete individual-site epistatic group or separation from alpha effects.
Fig.3 uses high-altitude hemolysates with alphaI/alphaII or alphaI/alphaII/alphaIII and betaI, matched to the same alpha mixtures with betaII. Avoid replacing these with a single alphaI genotype.
